development_policy: A/B schema improved on development; C applicability, citation mapping and literal scalar parsing revised on development only; archived preliminary runs retained.
primary_metric: Normalized required-value set plus answerability status, over all 90 held-out questions; errors are incorrect.
normalization: case folding, whitespace, bracket-citation removal, numeric unit suffixes, INR prefix and milliseconds-to-seconds conversion; ISO dates remain exact.
secondary_grading: Local same-model AI judge; random anonymous X/Y/Z configuration labels per question. No human answer grades or judge agreement estimate.
citation_grading: Actual bracket references only. All atomic factual claims form coverage denominator; unaccounted actually-used citations enter precision denominator as unsupported.
retrieval_measure: Macro evidence-group coverage over questions with gold supporting groups; insufficient cases not applicable. C prompt coverage is the verifier subset, while its B candidate saw the initial context.
conflict_measure: Unresolved-question status P/R/F1 across 90 questions, not 212-pair detection.
uncertainty: 10000 paired family bootstrap draws, seed 26014, 18 test families.
cost_policy: A then B then C in serial. C reuses B candidate; its logical latency and tokens include B plus verification. Cache and order effects limit runtime comparison.
